dataset_name: F-06 Investment Portfolio Risk and Scenario Analysis — Daily Historical Market Dataset
source: Yahoo Finance Chart endpoint (unofficial endpoint; see README limitations)

TCS.NS.symbol_note: Yahoo Finance symbol for NSE-listed TCS.

INFY.NS.symbol_note: Yahoo Finance symbol for NSE-listed Infosys.

HDFCBANK.NS.symbol_note: Yahoo Finance symbol for NSE-listed HDFC Bank.

^NSEI.symbol_note: Yahoo Finance symbol for NIFTY 50; generally no adjusted close or traded volume.

GOLDBEES.NS.symbol_note: Yahoo Finance symbol for Gold BeES ETF.

LIQUIDBEES.NS.symbol_note: Yahoo Finance symbol for Liquid BeES ETF.

schema.date: ISO-8601 market session date in Asia/Kolkata
schema.ticker: Yahoo Finance symbol; maps are included under assets
schema.open_high_low_close: Source-provided daily OHLC in INR. Yahoo's Close is generally split-adjusted; see source documentation and verify corporate actions.
schema.adjusted_close: Yahoo Finance Adj Close where returned; includes dividend/distribution adjustments as well as splits. Blank means source did not provide a value; it is not imputed.
schema.volume: Source volume where available; blank for assets such as indices without traded volume.
schema.currency: INR as the denomination for the requested NSE stocks, ETFs and NIFTY 50 index.

return_methodology.selected_price_field: adjusted_close when the symbol has adjusted-close observations; otherwise close only when adjusted_close is unavailable for that entire symbol (e.g. the NIFTY 50 price index). See return_price_basis.csv.
return_methodology.daily_returns: Percentage changes from consecutive observed values. No forward-fill, interpolation or fabricated values. A blank return remains blank when an adjacent observation is absent.
return_methodology.annualized_volatility: Sample standard deviation of daily returns multiplied by sqrt(252).
return_methodology.maximum_drawdown: Computed from a wealth index compounded from available daily returns; not a forward-looking risk forecast.

quality_checks.duplicate_key: Checked date+ticker duplicates. Exact duplicate rows are removed after being logged in duplicate_rows.csv. Conflicting duplicate values stop the script.
quality_checks.ohlc: Checked high >= max(open, close), low <= min(open, close), and high >= low; anomalies are listed in invalid_ohlc_rows.csv and not altered.
quality_checks.missing_dates: Compared each ticker with the observed ^NSEI date set when available; this is a proxy calendar, not an authoritative NSE holiday/session calendar. See missing_observations.csv.
quality_checks.nulls: Field-specific null counts per asset are in data_quality_summary.csv; nulls remain blank in CSV files.
quality_checks.corporate_actions: Dividends/distributions and splits returned in Yahoo chart events are listed in corporate_actions.csv. This may not be a complete or authoritative corporate-action ledger.

limitations: Yahoo Finance chart data is an unofficial endpoint, may be delayed, revised, throttled, unavailable for an instrument, or subject to licensing/redistribution restrictions.

This script records the actual retrieval timestamp when run; the workspace that prepared this script could not directly retrieve the raw market API, so no historical prices are embedded or fabricated in this package.
NIFTY 50 is a price index. Its close-based return excludes index dividend reinvestment; do not compare it as though it were a total-return index.
ETF market prices are not the same as NAV returns; adjusted close should be used for historical price-return calculations, and tracking error/NAV history are outside this dataset.

The shared observed-session comparison can identify asset-specific gaps on dates where the reference index has data; it cannot prove that all sources have no common missing session. An official NSE calendar would be needed for that.
Use the observations for a hackathon/research prototype only; independently verify critical results against licensed or official data before any investment decision.
